title: The Prediction and the Verification of the Neutrino Masses
content: In the present view on neutrinos three flavour states are recognized that are composed by a characteristic mixture of mass eigenstates. The absolute scale of these eigenstates is unknown. So far, observational experiments have revealed numerical values for the squared mass differences. In this article it is shown that mass ratios can be found as well. This enables the assessment of the absolute scale of the neutrino masses.
